practiceName: #8 tenant boundary and designed empty state (covers AC3 and AC6)
title: A teacher scoped to a different tenant sees only the designed empty screen, never another tenant's rows
turnSequence: Sign in as amira.north@example.test but choose the other membership ('Grade 5B · Ratio Reasoning', a different tenant with no assignments).
Assert the designed empty-state screen ('No learner results yet') renders instead of a generic error, and that no result table with the synthetic fractions run appears.
Role and permission screens are covered by the dashboard unit suites; this case proves the live tenant scoping and the designed no-data state.
expected: The teacher scoped to the other tenant sees the designed empty screen only; the synthetic-fractions run never crosses the tenant boundary.
observableFailure: Any row from the other tenant renders, or the no-data state is a generic error instead of the designed screen.
